title: ndcg_at_k: duplicate retrieved docs must be expanded as (id, occurrence) tuples, never by suffixing string IDs
answers: ndcg_at_k gives relevance to a non-relevant document whose ID contains a suffix like _bc574ae_2
NDCG score is nonzero even though no retrieved document matches the targets
how are duplicate retrieved documents handled in the legacy NDCG metric
retrieval evaluation NDCG wrong when document IDs look like generated duplicates
body:
Symptom: NDCG@k reports a positive score when none of the retrieved documents is relevant, e.g. targets ["a_bc574ae_2"] with predictions ["a", "a", "z"] scored about 0.63 instead of 0.
Root cause: mlflow/metrics/metric_definitions.py:_expand_duplicate_retrieved_docs built a second occurrence as the string f"{doc_id}_bc574ae_{n}" and then matched it against targets, so a real ID equal to that string was treated as relevant.
Fix pattern: represent each retrieved item as (original_id, occurrence_number) and build the relevant set from the original target set, adding (doc_id, k) only when the original doc_id is a target. Synthetic keys are never compared against the raw target strings.
Constraints: Applies to the legacy ndcg_at_k metric in metric_definitions.py. Relevant-duplicate behaviour (every occurrence of a relevant doc counts) is preserved. Short-retrieval-list handling and the GenAI scorers are not covered by this invariant.
Test guard: tests/metrics/test_metric_definitions.py:test_ndcg_at_k_preserves_relevance_when_ids_are_renamed checks that scores are unchanged after a bijective rename of all IDs; new NDCG cases should follow that pattern.
applies: Any change to duplicate handling or relevance matching in the legacy ndcg_at_k metric in mlflow/metrics/metric_definitions.py.
says: The search evaluation metric shows a positive score even when no retrieved document is relevant.
Retrieval ranking metrics report positive scores for completely irrelevant search results.
Ranking quality scores are incorrect when document identifiers contain underscore suffixes or duplicate numbers.
Search evaluation results should report zero relevance when none of the retrieved items match.
search: In mlflow/metrics/metric_definitions.py:_expand_duplicate_retrieved_docs, duplicate retrieved documents in legacy ndcg_at_k must be represented as (original_id, occurrence_number) tuples. Matching generated string suffixes like f"{doc_id}_bc574ae_{n}" against targets previously caused non-relevant documents with matching IDs to receive positive NDCG scores. The invariant applies strictly to legacy ndcg_at_k in metric_definitions.py, preserving relevant-duplicate behavior while excluding short-retrieval lists and GenAI scorers.
